'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Chris Fanchi DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
